title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1990-09-20
lineage: Dat > Sony PCM r500 > Tascam DA-3000 > flac 16/48
taper: Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick Master Digital Recording
source: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > M1000 Cables > Oade pre > Jensen 16 PS > Master Dat (Panasonic SV-250/48k).  Location: Sec A Row 18 Seat 01 (FOB, mics on stand @ 6'5")

ai_review.summary: Stunning audience capture with SchoePs mics and a transcendent Dark Star performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear room sound delivered by the SchoePs microphone array, describing it as one of the most faithful reproductions of the venue’s ambience. The show itself is highlighted for its powerful, love‑filled Dark Star that transports listeners to the “stream of consciousness” the band was aiming for.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars, praising both the musical performance (especially Dark Star) and the high‑fidelity audience recording; consistent, detailed feedback supports a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: SchoePs microphones provide an exceptionally clear, spacious capture of the room and crowd energy; reviewers note the recording reproduces the venue’s acoustics with remarkable fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The performance is described as a seamless, stream‑of‑consciousness experience that aligns with the band’s improvisational intent.
